newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEPOS, FX SWAPS HOLD IN LATE DEALINGS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEPOS, FX SWAPS HOLD IN LATE DEALINGS.

text.p: Greek depos were stable unaffected
by the central bank's draining of 250 billion drachmas of 14-day
funds in today's money tender and forex swaps were holding
Tuesday's levels, dealers said.
"Swaps are stable across the board in late trade," a state
bank dealer said. "Depos had a quiet day"
Bank of Greece soaked 250 billion drachmas of 14-day funds
in today's money tender with the weighted average interest rate
edging lower to 11.89 percent compared to 11.88 percent in last
week's tender.
"Liquidity has increased because sales of two-year zero
coupon bonds and 12-month T-bills amounting to 407 billion
drachmas were less than expiries of 500 billion," the dealer
said.
The central bank kept its intervention rate in overnight
money unchanged at 11.90 percent.
"Bonds were steady and trading was thin. Massive sales seen
in the previous days ceased and some buyers emerged. Prices
stabilised," a state bank bond dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 156.65/75 from Wednesday's 156.690
fix, the dollar at 268.42/52 drachmas from 268.300 and the Ecu
at 304.75/85 from 304.500 drachmas.
"Investors were cautious towards the drachma because of the
Albanian crisis. They were concerned of a possible drachma
instability if the crisis continued," a forex state bank dealer
said.
In Albania, the crisis has deepened as eyewitnesses say that
heavily armed insurgents have set up defence lines at the
entrance of the town of Sarande, ready to fight the Albanian
army.
Ecu/drachma was trading higher in late dealings, a forex
foreign bank dealer said.
"Ecu/drachma did not exhibit any great fluctuations on
Wednesday. It was trading at 304.60-70, the day's high, in late
dealings, after opening at 304.55-60 in the morning," the dealer
said.
"We do not expect it to fall below the 304.00 level," he
said.
The Albanian crisis is expected to influence foreign rather
than domestic investors, he added.
The National Bank of Greece , the domestic money
market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 11.45-11.95
** One week at 11.45-11.95
** Two weeks at 11.45-11.95
** Three weeks at 11.45-11.95
** One month at 11.45-11.95
** Two months at 11.35-11.85
** Three months at 11.25-11.75
** Six months at 11.00-11.50
** Nine months at 10.90-11.40
** Twelve months at 10.80-11.30
